name: trafwise
description: Request traffic control quotes worldwide, with local partner availability confirmed before a booking.

interface.longDescription: TrafWise accepts traffic control quote requests worldwide for roadworks, construction, utilities, tree works, filming and events. ChatGPT collects the site address, country, region, local time zone, dates, services and contact details, then asks for your confirmation before sending. The automatic partner network currently covers Australian states. Requests elsewhere go to the TrafWise team for manual follow-up to check local provider availability. A request does not guarantee a crew, service or booking. You can check status, review and accept quotes, update details or cancel your own requests. Sign in by email code. TrafWise takes no payments; providers quote and invoice directly. For emergencies, contact your local emergency service.
defaultPrompt: I need traffic controllers in London next Monday at 7am, Europe/London time.
Get a quote for a TMP and TGS for a crane lift in Brisbane.
What's the status of my traffic control request?

positive.prompt: What can TrafWise arrange and what details do you need from me?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains worldwide request intake, manual follow-up outside current partner coverage, local provider availability checks, required country/time zone and direct provider quotes.

positive.description: Send a quote request after confirmation (marked TEST so it is not sent to real companies)
positive.prompt: I need 2 traffic controllers at 10 Downing Street, London, GB, SW1A 2AA next Monday from 7am to 3pm, Europe/London time, for a TEST concrete pour. My name is App Reviewer, phone +44 20 7946 0000.
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT first shows a summary and asks for confirmation. After the reviewer says yes, it calls request_traffic_control with confirmed=true and returns a TW reference number. Requests whose description contains TEST are kept with TrafWise and not sent to partner companies.
Lists the reviewer account's recent requests, newest first, with reference, site, date and status.

positive.prompt: What's the status of my latest request?
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the status of the request, any quote and messages, and which companies have responded.

positive.description: Change and then cancel a request
positive.prompt: Change my latest request to start at 6am, then cancel it.
positive.expected_behavior: Confirms each change with the reviewer before acting, updates the start time, then cancels the request after explicit confirmation and reports the new status.

negative.prompt: There is an active road crash with injured people. Send emergency responders immediately.
Book me a plumber to fix a leaking tap.
Just send a traffic control request for my site, don't show me anything first.

review.commerce_description: TrafWise does not sell or take payments in ChatGPT. Traffic control companies quote and invoice the customer directly.

publication.release_notes: Corrected the worldwide availability declaration so reviewer credentials can be saved. Existing traffic-control quote tools, customer confirmation safeguards and dedicated reviewer sign-in retained.
